# Game Idea: Neon Grid Runner

A minimal endless‑runner on an HTML5 canvas. The player controls a glowing square that moves forward on a scrolling neon‑lit grid. Tap or click to switch between three lanes and avoid randomly spawning blocks. The game ends (lose condition) on collision with a block or after 2 minutes, and the score is the distance traveled.

1: // Minimal endless‑runner with enhanced graphics and sound
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas) return;
5:   // Adjust for high‑DPI screens
6:   const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
7:   const W = canvas.clientWidth || 300;
8:   const H = canvas.clientHeight || 150;
9:   canvas.width = W * dpr;
10:   canvas.height = H * dpr;
11:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
12:   ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
13: 
14:   // Audio setup
15:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
16:   function playTone(freq, type='sine', duration=0.1){
17:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
18:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
19:     osc.type = type;
20:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
21:     osc.connect(gain);
22:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
23:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
24:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
25:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
26:     osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
27:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
28:   }
29:   function playMove(){ playTone(400, 'triangle', 0.08); }
30:   function playCollision(){ playTone(100, 'sawtooth', 0.3); }
31:   function playBackground(){
32:     // simple continuous low drone
33:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
34:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
35:     osc.type = 'sine';
36:     osc.frequency.value = 60;
37:     osc.connect(gain);
38:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
39:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
40:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.05, audioCtx.currentTime + 1);
41:     osc.start();
42:     // store for later stop
43:     return {osc, gain};
44:   }
45:   const bg = playBackground();
46: 
47:   // lanes (three equally spaced)
48:   const laneCount = 3;
49:   const laneWidth = W / laneCount;
50:   const playerSize = 20;
51:   let playerLane = 1; // 0:left,1:center,2:right
52:   const playerY = H - playerSize - 10;
53: 
54:   // blocks
55:   const blocks = [];
56:   const blockSize = 20;
57:   const blockSpeed = 2; // pixels per frame
58:   const spawnInterval = 800; // ms
59:   let lastSpawn = 0;
60: 
61:   let startTime = null;
62:   const maxTime = 120000; // 2 minutes
63:   let score = 0;
64:   let running = true;
65: 
66:   function spawnBlock(){
67:     const lane = Math.floor(Math.random()*laneCount);
68:     blocks.push({lane, y: -blockSize});
69:   }
70: 
71:   function update(dt){
72:     if(!running) return;
73:     const now = performance.now();
74:     if(!startTime) startTime = now;
75:     const elapsed = now - startTime;
76:     if(elapsed >= maxTime){ running = false; playCollision(); alert('Time up! Score: '+Math.floor(score)); return; }
77:     // spawn
78:     if(now - lastSpawn > spawnInterval){
79:       spawnBlock();
80:       lastSpawn = now;
81:     }
82:     // move blocks
83:     for(let i=blocks.length-1;i>=0;i--){
84:       const b = blocks[i];
85:       b.y += blockSpeed;
86:       // collision
87:       const px = laneWidth*playerLane + laneWidth/2 - playerSize/2;
88:       const py = playerY;
89:       if(b.lane===playerLane && b.y+blockSize>py && b.y<py+playerSize){
90:         running = false;
91:         playCollision();
92:         alert('Game Over! Score: '+Math.floor(score));
93:         return;
94:       }
95:       // remove off‑screen
96:       if(b.y>H) blocks.splice(i,1);
97:     }
98:     // score based on distance (time)
99:     score = elapsed/10; // arbitrary scaling
100:   }
101: 
102:   function draw(){
103:     // background gradient
104:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,W,H);
105:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0,'#001');
106:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1,'#004');
107:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
108:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
109:     // neon glow settings
110:     ctx.shadowColor = 'cyan';
111:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
112:     // draw grid lines
113:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.3)';
114:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
115:     for(let i=1;i<laneCount;i++){
116:       ctx.beginPath();
117:       ctx.moveTo(i*laneWidth,0);
118:       ctx.lineTo(i*laneWidth,H);
119:       ctx.stroke();
120:     }
121:     // draw player with glow
122:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
123:     const px = laneWidth*playerLane + laneWidth/2 - playerSize/2;
124:     ctx.fillRect(px, playerY, playerSize, playerSize);
125:     // draw blocks with glow
126:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';
127:     blocks.forEach(b=>{
128:       const x = laneWidth*b.lane + laneWidth/2 - blockSize/2;
129:       ctx.fillRect(x, b.y, blockSize, blockSize);
130:     });
131:     // draw score
132:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
133:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
134:     ctx.font = '14px monospace';
135:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+Math.floor(score),10,20);
136:   }
137: 
138:   function loop(timestamp){
139:     if(running){
140:       const dt = timestamp - (lastRender||timestamp);
141:       update(dt);
142:       draw();
143:       lastRender = timestamp;
144:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
145:     }
146:   }
147:   // lane change on click/tap
148:   canvas.addEventListener('click',()=>{
149:     if(!running) return;
150:     // resume audio context if needed
151:     if(audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
152:     playerLane = (playerLane + 1) % laneCount;
153:     playMove();
154:   });
155:   // start loop
156:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
157: })();

(End of file - total 157 lines)
</content>
